title: DreamRO

description.en: Nostalgic 3D browser RPG with 20 classes, three realms, and local saves
description.zh: 怀旧风格的 3D 网页角色扮演游戏，提供 20 种职业、三大区域和本地存档。

websiteSource: GitHub repository homepage and README.md linked game preview
subject: Gold compass star with a smaller sage star

source.description: Nostalgic 3D browser RPG with 20 classes, three realms, and local saves

subject.en: A crafted shield behind a bow and arrow, sword and magic staff
subject.zh: 盾牌在后，弓箭、长剑与魔法杖在前的精制武器徽记

description.en: A timber shield anchors the back of the composition. A curved bow and arrow, steel sword and gemstone staff overlap in front as one compact equipment assembly. A gentle product-camera perspective preserves every weapon tip and the shield’s complete rim.
description.zh: 木盾稳住后景，弓箭、钢剑与宝石法杖在前方交叠，组成紧凑的冒险装备徽记。温和的产品摄影视角保留每一处武器尖端与完整盾缘。

description.en: Weathered timber, engraved antique gold, wrapped leather and polished steel give each object a distinct physical surface. One violet gemstone catches the light above the staff. This game emblem follows the physical-object series with continuous material shading.
description.zh: 旧木、雕刻古金、缠绕皮革与抛光钢材各有明确质感，法杖顶部的紫晶接住高光。这枚游戏徽记采用拟物系列的连续材质明暗。

description.en: Pale parchment carries a fine interlaced lozenge lattice and small heraldic corner stitches. A separate projected shadow lifts the shield and weapons gently from the page. Bright metal highlights remain in the foreground; the paper and shadow remain independent.
description.zh: 浅羊皮纸铺有精细交织菱格与小型纹章角饰，独立的投影让盾牌和武器轻轻浮起。金属高光保留在前景，纸面与阴影各自独立。

palette.source: Selected local presentation, dreamro/2026-09-07-01/02; background.base in archived settings.json

sizeNote.en: The shield and crossing weapon silhouettes carry the 32/16 px identity; engraved metal, the bowstring and timber grain resolve mainly in larger views. Browser and sidebar marks use the transparent equipment assembly. Large presentations use the parchment tile.
sizeNote.zh: 32/16 px 依靠盾牌与交叠武器的轮廓识别；金属雕花、弓弦与木纹主要在大图中呈现。浏览器和侧栏使用透明装备组合，大幅展示使用羊皮纸底图。

goal.en: Explore an RO-inspired single-player RPG in the browser, from character creation and quests to combat and local progress.
goal.zh: 在浏览器中体验 RO 风格的单人 RPG，创建角色、探索地图、完成任务并保存进度。

role.zh: 程序化三维角色、地图与特效

description.en: Interlaced lozenges and short corner stitches recall crafted heraldry around the shield and weapons.
description.zh: 交织菱格与短短的角部缝线，围绕盾牌和武器留下手作纹章的质感。

alt.en: A crafted shield behind a bow and arrow, sword and magic staff on a Hexly campaign canvas
alt.zh: 盾牌在后，弓箭、长剑与魔法杖在前的精制武器徽记，置于 Hexly 宣发画布

caption.en: Return to a world of adventure.

description.en: Crafted shield behind a bow and arrow, sword and magic staff.
description.zh: 盾牌在后，弓箭、长剑与魔法杖在前的精制武器徽记。

description.en: Preserve the exact project identity and the separately recorded Hexly artwork. Hexly paper, ink and terracotta belong to archive and campaign surfaces only; independent product palettes and themes stay their own.
description.zh: 项目原标与单独记录的 Hexly 主视觉均保持形状和原色。Hexly 纸色、墨色和陶土色只用于档案及宣发画布，各产品色板与主题独立保留。

description.en: Preserve the complete subject and its original square margins. Resize uniformly; never trim the canvas to force detail. Keep external clear space of at least 1/8 of the mark canvas height around standalone marks and lockups. Wide and mobile Heroes are separate compositions of existing artwork, with no image-model call.
description.zh: 保留完整主体与原有方形留白，只做等比缩放，不裁图强凑细节。独立标志及字标组合四周，至少留出标志画布高度 1/8 的外部净空。宽幅与手机 Hero 分别排版，没有新图像模型调用。

description.en: Navigation 24px preferred, 16px minimum. Wordmark ≥107px wide; lockup ≥160px. Use transparent PNG/ICO at small sizes without a tile, extra red dot, shadow or rounded mask. Fine facets soften at 16px.
description.zh: 导航推荐 24px，最小 16px。字标宽度至少 107px，组合至少 160px。小尺寸使用透明 PNG/ICO，不加底板、红点、阴影或圆角遮罩；16px 时细小切面会柔化。
